# Vortex — Data Topography
Source: Neuform staff featured templates. Author: Samnang Aing (@samnang). Views: 21; favorites: 3; remixes: 0.
Tags: dashboard, animated, webgl, threejs, dither, charts, navigation, links.
## Overview
Vortex Data Dashboard Section is designed for demonstrating application workflows and interface hierarchy. Key features include clear information density, modular panels, and interface rhythm. It is suitable for product showcases, admin panels, and analytics experiences.

Vortex Topography Data Streams Mesh Guides Request Beta v.09 / synchronized N 34°·05 — W 118°·24 Map every packet. Visualize the hidden stream. An active topography platform that tracks how data moves through your distr…
## Composition
Use the attached HTML reference as the source of truth. Preserve the visible hierarchy, first-screen composition, section rhythm, density, and interaction tone before adapting copy or content.
Key visible headings include: Map every packet. Visualize the hidden stream.; Topography Map; Active Metrics; Intelligent Paths.
## Colors
Anchor the palette in primary #F5A84B, secondary #F2EEE5, accent #7EDFD2, background #F2EEE5, surface #391400, text-primary #111827. Keep background, surface, text, and border roles distinct so generated layouts retain the same contrast pattern as the source.
## Typography
Use Bricolage Grotesque for display moments and Geist for body copy unless the HTML clearly demands a compatible fallback. Labels and technical metadata should use IBM Plex Mono or an equivalent mono face.
## Layout
Keep spacing deliberate and stable. Favor the same grid direction, max-width behavior, card density, and responsive stacking seen in the HTML. Do not replace distinctive source structures with generic SaaS sections.
## Components
Dashboard, chart, and data panels should preserve their compact operational hierarchy, nested surfaces, and metric emphasis.
## Motion
Preserve existing motion cues such as masked reveals, staggered entrance, hover lift, scroll-triggered transitions, and ambient movement. Keep easing smooth and restrained.
## WebGL & Effects

If the source includes canvas, WebGL, Three.js, gradients, particles, or atmospheric effects, rebuild them as supporting layers behind the content. Keep effects performant, responsive, and secondary to the interface.

## Guardrails
- Do not flatten the source into a generic card grid.
- Do not swap the color mode unless the source clearly supports it.
- Preserve the first viewport signal, focal object, and visual density.
- Keep buttons, cards, and badges aligned to the same radius and border language.

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #050608;
      --panel: rgba(12, 15, 18, 0.72);
      --panel-strong: rgba(14, 17, 21, 0.88);
      --paper: #f2eee5;
      --muted: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.62);
      --soft: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.38);
      --line: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.10);
      --line-strong: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.18);

      --amber: #f5a84b;

      --red: #c83d32;
      --lime: #bddb72;
      --cyan: #7edfd2;

      --display: "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif;

      --mono: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace;

      --ease: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      background: var(--bg);
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      font-family: var(--body);
      color: var(--paper);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 76% 20%, rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.16), transparent 34rem),
        radial-gradient(circle at 12% 76%, rgba(126, 223, 210, 0.09), transparent 34rem),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #050608 0%, #090b0e 48%, #0b0907 100%);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
      selection-color: #050608;
      selection-background: var(--amber);
    }

    a,
    button {
      color: inherit;
      font: inherit;
    }

    a {
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    button {
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    #webgl-canvas {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0.96;
    }

    .bg-layer {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .bg-layer::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.98) 0%, rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.78) 34%, rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.20) 67%, rgba(5, 6, 8, 0.82) 100%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 52% 54%, transparent 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48) 70%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72) 100%);
    }

    .bg-layer::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0.06;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.8) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.8) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 44px 44px;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 63% 48%, black 0%, transparent 74%);
    }

    .noise {
      position: fixed;
      inset: -50%;
      z-index: 2;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0.045;
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 260 260' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.75' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      animation: grain 9s steps(6) infinite;
      mix-blend-mode: overlay;
    }

    .center-guide {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 3;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .center-guide::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 53.5%;
      width: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.08), transparent);
    }

    .orbital-ring {
      position: fixed;
      right: -22vw;
      top: -22vw;
      width: 78vw;
      height: 78vw;
      z-index: 3;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.08);
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: rotate(-16deg);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 120px rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.035);
      animation: driftRing 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .orbital-ring::before,
    .orbital-ring::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: inherit;
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.10);
    }

    .orbital-ring::before {
      inset: 8%;
    }

    .orbital-ring::after {
      inset: 18%;
      border-color: rgba(126, 223, 210, 0.08);
    }

    .shell {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      width: min(100%, 1600px);
      min-height: 100vh;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 28px clamp(22px, 4vw, 64px) 36px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 28px;
      padding: 8px 0 18px;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 13px;
      font-weight: 620;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      position: relative;
      width: 39px;
      height: 39px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.14);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 32% 26%, rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.86), transparent 36%),
        linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.13), rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.03));
      box-shadow:
        0 18px 55px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34),
        0 0 42px rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.12),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
    }

    .brand-mark::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(126, 223, 210, 0.70);
      border-left-color: transparent;
      transform: rotate(-30deg);
    }

    .brand span:last-child {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .brand small {
      margin-top: 4px;
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.42);
    }

    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 7px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.10);
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(7, 9, 11, 0.48);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
    }

    .nav a {
      height: 34px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 15px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.56);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 450;
      transition: color 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .nav a:hover,
    .nav a.active {
      color: var(--paper);
      background: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.075);
    }

    .header-cta {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      height: 44px;
      padding: 0 7px 0 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      color: #fff8ec;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 245, 225, 0.18), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.00) 38%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #d75927 0%, #f5a84b 48%, #f1cf78 100%);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 720;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(57, 20, 0, 0.42);
      box-shadow:
        0 18px 44px rgba(231, 100, 43, 0.22),
        0 8px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52),
        inset 0 -10px 18px rgba(103, 35, 12, 0.28),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 222, 160, 0.36);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, filter 0.25s ease;
    }

    .header-cta::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 1px;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), transparent);
      transform: translateX(-120%);
      animation: shimmer 5.4s ease-in-out infinite;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .header-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      filter: saturate(1.08);
      box-shadow:
        0 24px 58px rgba(231, 100, 43, 0.30),
        0 10px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58),
        inset 0 -10px 18px rgba(103, 35, 12, 0.30),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 230, 178, 0.44);
    }

    .header-cta span {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: #fff4df;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 32% 22%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22), transparent 34%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #15110d, #060708);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
        0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    }

    .hero {
      flex: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.04fr) minmax(410px, 0.78fr);
      align-items: end;
      gap: clamp(34px, 5vw, 76px);
      padding: clamp(68px, 12vh, 130px) 0 42px;
    }

    .copy {
      max-width: 840px;
    }

    .status-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      font-family: var(--mono);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.48);
    }

    .status-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 8px 11px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.10);
      background: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.035);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
    }

    .status-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--lime);
      box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(189, 219, 114, 0.7);
      animation: pulseDot 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .headline {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: clamp(58px, 8.3vw, 132px);
      line-height: 0.86;
      letter-spacing: -0.075em;
      color: var(--paper);
      max-width: 980px;
      text-wrap: balance;
      perspective: 900px;
    }

    .headline-line {
      position: relative;
      display: block;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 0.04em 0 0.16em;
      margin-bottom: -0.11em;
    }

    .headline-line::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 8%;
      bottom: 0.08em;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.35), rgba(126, 223, 210, 0.18), transparent);
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: left;
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .headline-line>span {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;
      transform: translateY(118%) rotateX(18deg) rotate(1.8deg) scale(0.98);
      transform-origin: left bottom;
      filter: blur(18px);
      opacity: 0;
      will-change: transform, opacity, filter;
    }

    .loaded .headline-line>span {
      animation: headlineReveal 1.18s var(--ease) forwards;
      animation-delay: var(--delay, 0s);
    }

    .loaded .headline-line::after {
      animation: headlineRule 1.15s var(--ease) forwards;
      animation-delay: calc(var(--delay, 0s) + .18s);
    }

    .headline .muted {
      color: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.48);
      font-weight: 360;
      text-shadow: 0 0 34px rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.055);
    }

    .headline .accent {
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18)),
        linear-gradient(94deg, #fff1cf 0%, #f5a84b 31%, #e7642b 62%, #7edfd2 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
      font-style: italic;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 28px rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.16));
    }

    .subcopy {
      max-width: 590px;
      margin-top: 34px;
      color: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.62);
      font-size: clamp(15px, 1.25vw, 18px);
      line-height: 1.72;
      letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    }

    .actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 38px;
    }

    .btn-primary,
    .btn-secondary {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 52px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0 22px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 620;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      color: #fff8ec;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 246, 228, 0.22), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.00) 42%),
        linear-gradient(135deg, #bd3f24 0%, #e7642b 36%, #f5a84b 72%, #f3ca72 100%);
      text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(44, 13, 0, 0.48);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 222, 160, 0.34);
      box-shadow:
        0 24px 62px rgba(231, 100, 43, 0.24),
        0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.50),
        inset 0 -14px 24px rgba(89, 27, 8, 0.30);
    }

    .btn-primary::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 1px;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24), transparent 46%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .btn-primary::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38), transparent);
      transform: translateX(-120%);
      animation: shimmer 4.6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      color: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.90);
      border: 1px solid rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.16);
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.075), rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.028)),
        rgba(7, 9, 11, 0.66);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07),
        0 14px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover,
    .btn-secondary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      box-shadow:
        0 30px 76px rgba(231, 100, 43, 0.32),
        0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.56),
        inset 0 -14px 24px rgba(89, 27, 8, 0.32);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      border-color: rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.44);
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.10), rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.035)),
        rgba(9, 11, 13, 0.78);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
        0 18px 42px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24),
        0 0 34px rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.08);
    }

    .feature-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      max-width: 720px;
      margin-top: 58px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 148px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.095);
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 18px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.065), rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.025)),
        rgba(7, 9, 11, 0.54);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06),
        0 18px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.28s var(--ease), border-color 0.28s ease, background 0.28s ease;
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      border-color: rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.22);
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.08), rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.028)),
        rgba(9, 11, 13, 0.76);
    }

    .feature-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: auto 18px 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.55), transparent);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.28s ease;
    }

    .feature-card:hover::after {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 13px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--amber);
      background: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.055);
      border: 1px solid rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.09);
    }

    .feature-card h3 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 650;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .feature-card p {
      margin: 7px 0 0;
      color: rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.45);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.48;
    }

    .telemetry-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 460px;
      justify-self: end;
      align-self: center;
      transform: translateY(-46px);
    }

    .telemetry-panel {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 34px;
      padding: 1px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.20), rgba(242, 238, 229, 0.035) 50%, rgba(245, 168, 75, 0.14));
      box-shadow:
        0 44px 130px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42),

  </style>
</head>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      document.body.classList.add("loaded");

      const tickGroup = document.getElementById("dialTicks");

      if (tickGroup) {
        let html = "";

        for (let i = 0; i < 72; i++) {
          const angle = (i / 72) * Math.PI * 2;
          const major = i % 6 === 0;
          const r1 = major ? 82 : 91;
          const r2 = 101;
          const x1 = 110 + Math.cos(angle) * r1;
          const y1 = 110 + Math.sin(angle) * r1;
          const x2 = 110 + Math.cos(angle) * r2;
          const y2 = 110 + Math.sin(angle) * r2;
          const color = major ? "rgba(245,168,75,.9)" : "rgba(242,238,229,.16)";
          const width = major ? "1.5" : "1";

          html += `<line x1="${x1}" y1="${y1}" x2="${x2}" y2="${y2}" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="${width}" />`;
        }

        tickGroup.innerHTML = html;
      }
    });
  </script>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from "three";
    import { EffectComposer } from "three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js";
    import { RenderPass } from "three/addons/postprocessing/RenderPass.js";
    import { UnrealBloomPass } from "three/addons/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js";
    import { ShaderPass } from "three/addons/postprocessing/ShaderPass.js";
    import { OutputPass } from "three/addons/postprocessing/OutputPass.js";

    let scene;
    let camera;
    let renderer;
    let composer;
    let bloomPass;
    let blurPass;
    let outputPass;
    let floorMesh;

    const clock = new THREE.Clock();
    let globalTime = 0;
    const trailObjects = [];
    const trailMaterials = [];

    const pointer = new THREE.Vector2(0, 0);
    const easedPointer = new THREE.Vector2(0, 0);

    const config = {
      dpr: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.6),
      exposure: 2.45,
      brightness: 2.75,
      bloomStrength: 0.42,
      bloomRadius: 0.55,
      bloomThreshold: 0.02,
      speedMultiplier: 0.105,
      linesCount: 118,
      dotDensity: 74,
      dotSize: 0.19,
      dotSpeed: 1.45,
      blurStrength: 4.2,
      arcRadius: 15.5,
      bendStartZ: -126.0,
      floorLength: 148.0,
      wallHeight: 205.0,
      color0: "#120806",
      color1: "#c83d32",
      color2: "#e7642b",
      color3: "#f5a84b",
      color4: "#7edfd2",
      color5: "#f2eee5"
    };

    class PerformanceCurve extends THREE.Curve {
      constructor(x, zStart, zBend, radius, yEnd) {
        super();
        this.x = x;
        this.zStart = zStart;
        this.zBend = zBend;
        this.radius = radius;
        this.yEnd = yEnd;
        this.L_flat = Math.abs(zStart - (zBend + radius));
        this.L_arc = Math.PI * radius * 0.5;
        this.L_up = Math.max(0.1, yEnd - radius);
        this.totalLength = this.L_flat + this.L_arc + this.L_up;
      }

      getPoint(t, output = new THREE.Vector3()) {
        const d = t * this.totalLength;
        let py = 0;
        let pz = 0;

        if (d <= this.L_flat) {
          pz = this.zStart - d;
        } else if (d <= this.L_flat + this.L_arc) {
          const n = (d - this.L_flat) / this.L_arc;
          const e = n * n * (3 - 2 * n);
          const a = (n * 0.36 + e * 0.64) * Math.PI * 0.5;
          py = this.radius * (1 - Math.cos(a));
          pz = (this.zBend + this.radius) - Math.sin(a) * this.radius;
        } else {
          py = this.radius + (d - (this.L_flat + this.L_arc));
          pz = this.zBend;
        }

        return output.set(this.x, py, pz);
      }
    }

    init();
    animate();

    function init() {
      const canvas = document.querySelector("#webgl-canvas");

      scene = new THREE.Scene();
      scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x000000);

      camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(54, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 1, 2000);
      camera.position.set(0, 16, 132);
      camera.lookAt(0, 26, -62);

      renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
        canvas,
        antialias: true,
        powerPreference: "high-performance"
      });

      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      renderer.setPixelRatio(config.dpr);
      renderer.toneMapping = THREE.LinearToneMapping;
      renderer.toneMappingExposure = config.exposure;

      const renderTarget = new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(
        window.innerWidth * config.dpr,
        window.innerHeight * config.dpr,
        {
          type: THREE.HalfFloatType,
          format: THREE.RGBAFormat
        }
      );

      const renderScene = new RenderPass(scene, camera);

      bloomPass = new UnrealBloomPass(
        new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight),
        config.bloomStrength,
        config.bloomRadius,
        config.bloomThreshold
      );

      const blurShader = {
        uniforms: {
          tDiffuse: { value: null },
          resolution: { value: new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth * config.dpr, window.innerHeight * config.dpr) },
          blurStrength: { value: config.blurStrength }
        },
        vertexShader: `
          varying vec2 vUv;

          void main() {
            vUv = uv;
            gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
          }
        `,
        fragmentShader: `
          uniform sampler2D tDiffuse;
          uniform vec2 resolution;
          uniform float blurStrength;
          varying vec2 vUv;

          void main() {
            float mask = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.58, vUv.y);
            float radius = mask * blurStrength;

            if (radius < 0.1) {
              gl_FragColor = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
            } else {
              vec4 color = vec4(0.0);
              float total = 0.0;
              const float goldenAngle = 2.3999632;

              for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
                float f = float(i);
                float r = sqrt(f) * radius;
                float theta = f * goldenAngle;
                vec2 offset = vec2(cos(theta), sin(theta)) * (r / resolution);
                color += texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv + offset);
                total += 1.0;
              }

              gl_FragColor = color / total;
            }
          }
        `
      };

      blurPass = new ShaderPass(blurShader);
      outputPass = new OutputPass();

      composer = new EffectComposer(renderer, renderTarget);
      composer.setPixelRatio(config.dpr);
      composer.addPass(renderScene);
      composer.addPass(bloomPass);
      composer.addPass(blurPass);
      composer.addPass(outputPass);

      createFloor();
      generateTrails();
      updateGeometries();

      window.addEventListener("resize", onWindowResize);
      window.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove, { passive: true });
    }

    function createFloor() {
      const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x000000,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.965,
        depthWrite: false,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide
      });

      floorMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), material);
      floorMesh.position.set(0, -0.5, -0.5);
      floorMesh.renderOrder = 1;
      scene.add(floorMesh);
    }

    function generateTrails() {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      scene.add(group);

      const vertexShader = `
        varying vec2 vUv;
        varying vec3 vNormal;
        varying vec3 vViewPosition;

        void main() {
          vUv = uv;
          vNormal = normalMatrix * normal;
          vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
          vViewPosition = -mv.xyz;
          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
        }
      `;

      const fragmentShader = `
        varying vec2 vUv;
        varying vec3 vNormal;
        varying vec3 vViewPosition;

        uniform float uTime;
        uniform vec3 uColor;
        uniform float uSpeed;
        uniform float uOffset;
        uniform float uTailLength;
        uniform float uIntensityMultiplier;
        uniform float uBendUv;
        uniform float uIsReflection;
        uniform float uDotDensity;
        uniform float uDotSize;
        uniform float uDotSpeed;
        uniform float uBrightness;

        float hash(vec2 p) {
          return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
        }

        void main() {
          float t = fract(uTime * uSpeed + uOffset);
          float dist = fract(t - vUv.x + 1.0);

          float baseAlpha = smoothstep(uTailLength, 0.0, dist);
          baseAlpha = pow(max(0.0, baseAlpha), 1.22);

          vec3 viewDir = normalize(vViewPosition);
          float fresnel = abs(dot(normalize(vNormal), viewDir));
          float edgeSoftener = smoothstep(0.0, 0.025, fresnel);
          baseAlpha *= edgeSoftener;

          float core = pow(max(0.0, baseAlpha), 3.2) * 1.35;

          float movingUv = vUv.x - (uTime * uSpeed * uDotSpeed) - uOffset;
          float sp = movingUv * uDotDensity;
          float dotId = floor(sp);
          float dotLocal = fract(sp);

          float dotShape = length(vec2(
            (dotLocal - 0.5) * 2.0,
            (fract(vUv.y + 0.5) - 0.5) * 6.0
          ));

          float dotMask = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, max(0.001, uDotSize), dotShape);
          float dotRand = step(0.62, hash(vec2(dotId, uOffset)));
          float dotPulse = sin(uTime * 4.0 + hash(vec2(dotId)) * 6.28) * 0.28 + 0.72;
          float dotFinal = dotMask * dotRand * dotPulse * baseAlpha;

          if (uIsReflection > 0.5) {
            float reflectionFade = 1.0 - smoothstep(uBendUv - 0.015, uBendUv, vUv.x);
            baseAlpha *= reflectionFade;
            core *= reflectionFade;
            dotFinal *= reflectionFade * 0.08;

            baseAlpha = pow(max(0.0, baseAlpha), 0.55) *
              (0.58 + hash(vUv * 210.0 + uTime * 0.05) * 0.42);

            core *= 0.28;
          }

          vec3 trailColor = uColor * (baseAlpha + core * 1.45) * uIntensityMultiplier * uBrightness;
          vec3 rgb = trailColor / max(1.0 - clamp(dotFinal * 1.75, 0.0, 0.94), 0.001)
            + uColor * dotFinal * 2.25 * uIntensityMultiplier * uBrightness;

          gl_FragColor = vec4(rgb, (baseAlpha + dotFinal) * uIntensityMultiplier);
        }
      `;

      for (let i = 0; i < config.linesCount; i++) {
        const normalized = (i / (config.linesCount - 1)) * 2 - 1;
        const eased = Math.sign(normalized) * Math.pow(Math.abs(normalized), 1.28);

        let startX = (normalized * 0.34 + eased * 0.66) * 92;
        startX += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.8;

        const thickness = Math.random() * 0.18 + 0.06;

        let colorIndex;
        const colorRoll = Math.random();

        if (colorRoll < 0.36) colorIndex = 2;
        else if (colorRoll < 0.62) colorIndex = 3;
        else if (colorRoll < 0.80) colorIndex = 4;
        else if (colorRoll < 0.93) colorIndex = 1;
        else colorIndex = 5;

        const uniforms = {
          uTime: { value: 0 },
          uColor: { value: new THREE.Color(config[`color${colorIndex}`]) },
          uSpeed: { value: Math.random() * 0.46 + 0.22 },
          uOffset: { value: Math.random() },
          uTailLength: { value: Math.random() * 0.36 + 0.28 },
          uIntensityMultiplier: { value: 1.0 },
          uBendUv: { value: 0.0 },
          uIsReflection: { value: 0.0 },
          uDotDensity: { value: config.dotDensity },
          uDotSize: { value: config.dotSize },
          uDotSpeed: { value: config.dotSpeed },
          uBrightness: { value: config.brightness }
        };

        const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
          vertexShader,
          fragmentShader,
          uniforms,
          transparent: true,
          depthWrite: false,
          blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
        });

        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), material);

        const reflectionMaterial = material.clone();
        reflectionMaterial.uniforms.uIntensityMultiplier.value = 0.22;
        reflectionMaterial.uniforms.uIsReflection.value = 1.0;

        const reflectionMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), reflectionMaterial);
        reflectionMesh.scale.y = -1;
        reflectionMesh.position.y = -1.0;

        group.add(mesh, reflectionMesh);

        trailMaterials.push(material.uniforms, reflectionMaterial.uniforms);
        trailObjects.push({ mesh, reflectionMesh, startX, thickness });
      }
    }

    function updateGeometries() {
      if (floorMesh.geometry) floorMesh.geometry.dispose();

      const floorGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1000, 1000, 1, 1500);
      floorGeometry.rotateX(-Math.PI * 0.5);

      const positions = floorGeometry.attributes.position.array;

      for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 3) {
        if (positions[i + 2] < config.bendStartZ) {
          const distance = config.bendStartZ - positions[i + 2];
          const maxArc = config.arcRadius * Math.PI * 0.5;

          if (distance < maxArc) {
            const n = distance / maxArc;
            const eased = n * n * (3 - 2 * n);
            const angle = (n * 0.36 + eased * 0.64) * Math.PI * 0.5;

            positions[i + 1] = config.arcRadius * (1 - Math.cos(angle));
            positions[i + 2] = config.bendStartZ - Math.sin(angle) * config.arcRadius;
          } else {
            positions[i + 1] = config.arcRadius + (distance - maxArc);
            positions[i + 2] = config.bendStartZ - config.arcRadius;
          }
        }
      }

      floorGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
      floorMesh.geometry = floorGeometry;

      const bendUv = Math.abs(config.floorLength - config.bendStartZ) /
        (
          Math.abs(config.floorLength - config.bendStartZ) +
          Math.PI * config.arcRadius * 0.5 +
          Math.max(0.1, config.wallHeight - config.arcRadius)
        );

      trailObjects.forEach((object) => {
        const path = new PerformanceCurve(
          object.startX,
          config.floorLength,
          config.bendStartZ - config.arcRadius,
          config.arcRadius,
          config.wallHeight
        );

        const geometry = new THREE.TubeGeometry(path, 210, object.thickness, 8, false);

        if (object.mesh.geometry) object.mesh.geometry.dispose();

        object.mesh.geometry = geometry;
        object.reflectionMesh.geometry = geometry;

        object.mesh.material.uniforms.uBendUv.value = bendUv;
        object.reflectionMesh.material.uniforms.uBendUv.value = bendUv;
      });
    }

    function onPointerMove(event) {
      pointer.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
      pointer.y = (event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 - 1;
    }

    function onWindowResize() {
      config.dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1.6);

      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      renderer.setPixelRatio(config.dpr);
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

      composer.setPixelRatio(config.dpr);
      composer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

      blurPass.uniforms.resolution.value.set(
        window.innerWidth * config.dpr,
        window.innerHeight * config.dpr
      );
    }

    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      const delta = clock.getDelta();
      globalTime += delta * config.speedMultiplier;

      trailMaterials.forEach((materialUniforms) => {
        materialUniforms.uTime.value = globalTime;
      });

      easedPointer.lerp(pointer, 0.035);

      camera.position.x = easedPointer.x * 7;
      camera.position.y = 16 - easedPointer.y * 3.5;
      camera.lookAt(easedPointer.x * 4, 26, -62);

      composer.render();
    }
  </script>
</body>

</html>
